sobreNosotros.title: About Us
sobreNosotros.intro1: CEPTI is an innovative manufacturer of cutting-edge decoration materials for all types of interior and exterior surfaces, that will transform and expand the limits of your decoration ideas for less money.
sobreNosotros.intro2: CEPTI was founded in 2017 to implement tomorrow's technologies and introduce new, unique, and innovative solutions that could already today meet the future needs of the Dominican Republic and the wider world.
objectives: Sourcing innovative technologies with modern ideas, from companies recognized as high-tech leaders around the world
Replacing expensive finishing materials with more affordable and safer alternatives
Cladding and protecting facades with diverse textures and colors created by nature
Implementing new design ideas and solutions for interiors and exteriors
Reducing imports of finishing construction materials
Raising the technological level of the Dominican Republic and other Latin American countries into the top ranks among the world's high-tech leaders
sobreNosotros.closing: All our products are protected against mold and fungus, are 100% eco-friendly, and easily withstand wet cleaning. Proven formulations that withstand the tropical climate without losing color or texture, with a service life of up to 10 years in interior and exterior designs. We also offer at least a 5-year warranty on the installation of our finishing materials, performed by our experts.
